band_change_evidence_test.reason: FAIL. The only sources located are company database profiles — Tracxn, PitchBook and Crunchbase — and partnership announcements, all at tier 2. No independent reporting, no institutional disclosure and no regulatory record about Typeface was obtained. Typeface cannot be verified at tier 4 in either direction, and is the thinnest entity in this study.

key_evidence: Typeface is the thinnest entity in this study. The only sources that exist about it are company database profiles and partnership press releases, all at tier 2.
Thirty-nine of its 40 subdimensions rest on complete absence of evidence. The single exception is that it has raised $206 million and made three acquisitions.
No adverse conduct of any kind was found. No lawsuits, no labour findings, no regulatory action, no safety incidents. The 22.8-point fall measures silence, not misconduct.
No responsible-AI policy, no ethics documentation, no workforce data and no impact reporting were located for a company valued at $1.0 billion.

The honest question this raises is whether an entity with no public record beyond funding data belongs in a published compassion ranking at all. That is a scope question for the index, not a scoring question.

evidence.claim: Typeface is a developer of an AI platform for personalised enterprise marketing content, valued at $1.0 billion, having raised $206 million over 2 rounds from 7 investors.
Typeface has completed three acquisitions: Narrato in September 2024, Treat and TensorTour.

Typeface and Google Cloud integrated agentic marketing orchestration in April 2026; Firstsource launched an agentic marketing service in partnership with Typeface in April 2026; Cognizant and Typeface partnered in January 2026.

notes: FLAG FOR REVIEW — NOT A DOWNGRADE. No score change is proposed for application. The published 48.4 is a never-assessed uniform-seed placeholder shared byte-for-byte with seven other ai-labs entities at consecutive alphabetical ranks; the rank is an artefact of the tie. No adverse conduct was located. The entire gap measures disclosure, not conduct. Applying a one-off baseline reset on evidence-absence alone would convert a calibration problem into a conduct finding, which the anti-false-positive screen forbids. Referred for coordinator-level calibration of the ai-labs 60.9 and 48.4 uniform-seed clusters. rotation-state composite/band/rank left at the PUBLISHED values.
